notes.title: Indiegogo Campaign Launched!
notes.content:
Gritstone Games has launched the Indiegogo campaign to remaster Tafl Champions: Ancient Chess bringing you new and improved features to create an even better experience!

We genuinely appreciate any help you can provide, whether that's contributing some funds yourself or sharing the campaign with anyone who might be interested!

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/tafl-champions-ancient-chess-viking-chess-game/reft/38186199/steam]Check out the campaign at Indiegogo![/url]

notes.title: Version 2 Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40199343/a4420f00fe0fc375410adbde13d055eee22d53aa.png[/img]

Gritstone Games is excited to announce that it has plans to remaster Tafl Champions: Ancient Chess with new and improved features in 2025!

We will be launching an Indiegogo fundraiser early next year - you can find out more by visiting our [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/tafl-champions-ancient-chess-v2-0/coming_soon]fund prelaunch page[/url]!

notes.content: Some small quality of life improvements

notes.title: v1.2.1 Update
notes.content: Fixed a blocking issue for new players

notes.title: 1.2 Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
There's some quality of life updates behind the scenes that will set it up nicely for future updates. No significant changes other than an engine upgrade. We hope to see you enjoying Tafl Champions: Ancient Chess in the upcoming Steam Strategy Festival!

Remember, you can continue playing your games on Android and iOS devices!

notes.title: v1.1 Update Release
notes.content:
Numerous quality of life improvements have been made. The login process has been refined, the Community tab has been revamped, a friends system has been introduced, a rulebook has been provided and you can now skip the tutorial!

We also have an internal news system so you can keep up to date on the latest announcements. You can also join us on our Discord server!

notes.title: v1.1 Beta Available
notes.content:
The v1.1 Beta candidate is now available for testing. There are number of improvements to the game based on feedback and our own analysis. We would greatly appreciate any and all feedback as we try to bring the best experience to you.

If you would like to provide feedback, please visit [url=https://feedback.gritstone.games]Feedback @ Gritstone Games[/url]. We do read it all and we try to fit in what we can.

Improvements to the game include:
[list]
[*] Improved login/registration process
[*] Internal news system
[*] An entirely revamped Community tab, providing better matchmaking opportunities
[*] The ability to maintain a list of friends so you can challenge your favourite opponents
[*] Accessible rules so you can easily remind yourself how to play the game
[*] A tutorial skip button!
[/list]
... plus many more minor fixes.

We also have a [url=https://discord.gg/fqRvgmAq2c]Discord server[/url]! Be one of the first few members as hope to grow the Gritstone Games community.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.content: Fixed an issue where players would join the wrong server. If you encountered strange behaviour with the previous versions you are encouraged to uninstall and reinstall the game for a smooth transition.
